description: Schema for validating topic brief imports (CSV or JSON). Used by the import validator in Phase 2 (Topic Import). All fields are required unless marked optional.

headline.description: Suggested blog headline. Editable in the app after import.

source_question.description: The actual question a real person asked (from Reddit, Google PAA, etc). Displayed as 'Answering: "..."' throughout the pipeline. This is the grounding anchor.

emotion.description: The emotional state of the person asking the question. Used for content tone calibration and displayed as a tag.

folly_hook.description: The specific Folly science claim that addresses this question. Must be grounded in actual Folly science docs (1675mg actives, microsphere encapsulation, 98% B12 protection, 4-35x potency, etc). Passed to Claude as context for blog generation.

suggested_subject_line.description: Suggested email subject line. Should be under 50 chars (the app will flag if over). Editable after import.

segment.description: Target segment. Must match one of the 4 segment IDs.

freshness.description: How time-sensitive this topic is. Optional — defaults to evergreen.

csv.notes: CSV is the primary import format. Headers must match field names exactly. See topic-brief-template.csv for example.

json.notes: JSON is the secondary format for programmatic imports or NotebookLM data table exports converted to JSON.

validation_behavior.notes: Rejected rows are shown in an error summary. Valid rows are imported. Benoit can fix the CSV and re-import just the rejected rows.
